::: {.page-about name="Find, draw and name" uses="a hunt around the room or the school; draw each thing found, then label it from a word bank" pieces="panel, side-by-side, work-space, blank, recall"}
:::

Find 5 angles in the room. Draw each one and mark the {{< vocab "vertex" zh=true >}}. Then name it.

::: {.panel title="Angle names · 角的名称"}

:::

## 2. Compare

Choose one of your angles. Finish the sentence:

{{< frames "GD-FRM-046" zh=true >}}

::: {.recall lines="2"}
- Your sentence: | My angle is bigger than a right angle because it opens wider than the corner of a page.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-note title="Look for"}
Each drawing has a dot for the vertex. The names match the drawings: compare each with a right angle (a folded paper corner). The sentence uses *bigger than* or *smaller than* with a reason.
:::
:::
